    - match: \d+
      scope: meta.number.integer.decimal.cs constant.numeric.value.cs
    - match: '[\p{L}_-]+'
      scope: meta.string.cs string.unquoted.cs
    - include: expect-preprocessor-end

  preprocessor-pragma-warning-args:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.preprocessor.cs
    - match: (disable|restore)(?:\s+([\w-]+))?
      scope: meta.preprocessor.cs
      captures:
        1: keyword.control.directive.other.cs
        2: meta.string.cs string.unquoted.cs
      set: expect-preprocessor-end
    - include: expect-preprocessor-end

  expect-preprocessor-end:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_content_scope: meta.preprocessor.cs
    - match: $\n?|(?=\s*/[/*])
      scope: meta.preprocessor.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: \S+
      scope: invalid.illegal.cs

  expect-preprocessor-fold-begin:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_content_scope: meta.preprocessor.cs
    - match: '{{wspace_eol}}'
      scope: meta.preprocessor.cs meta.fold.block.begin.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: \s*(?=/[/*])
      scope: meta.fold.block.begin.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: \S+
      scope: invalid.illegal.cs

###[ GLOBAL BLOCKS ]###########################################################

  csharp-blocks:
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      push: inside-csharp-block

  inside-csharp-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.block.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: csharp

###[ ALIAS DECLARATIONS ]######################################################

  extern-alias-declarations:
    - match: (extern)\s+(alias)\b
      captures:
        1: storage.modifier.cs
        2: keyword.declaration.alias.cs
      push: extern-alias-declaration-name

  extern-alias-declaration-name:
    - meta_scope: meta.alias.cs
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.namespace.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

###[ USING DECLARATIONS ]######################################################

  using-declarations:
    - match: (?:(global)\s+)?(using)\b
      captures:
        1: storage.modifier.cs
        2: keyword.declaration.using.cs
      push:
        - using-meta
        - using-type

  using-meta:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.using.cs
    - include: immediately-pop

  using-type:
    - match: static\b
      scope: storage.modifier.static.cs
      set: using-namespace
    - match: ({{name}})\s*(=)\s*(?=\()
      captures:
        1: entity.name.type.cs
        2: keyword.operator.assignment.cs
      set: type-tuple
    - match: ({{name}})\s*(=)
      captures:
        1: variable.other.import.cs
        2: keyword.operator.assignment.cs
      set: using-namespace
    - match: (?=var\b|{{namespaced_name}}\s+{{name}})
      set:
        - expression-list
        - var-declaration
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: using-namespace

  using-namespace:
    - include: accessors
    - include: namespace-variables
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.namespace.cs
      push:
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - include: else-pop

###[ NAMESPACE DECLARATIONS ]##################################################

  namespace-declarations:
    # package declaration
    - match: namespace\b
      scope: meta.namespace.cs keyword.declaration.namespace.cs
      push:
        - namespace-declaration-block
        - namespace-declaration-name

  namespace-declaration-name:
    - match: ({{unreserved_name}})\s*(\.)
      captures:
        1: variable.namespace.cs
        2: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.name.namespace.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  namespace-declaration-block:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.namespace.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-namespace-declaration-block
    - include: else-pop

  inside-namespace-declaration-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.namespace.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - include: inside-csharp-block

###[ CLASS DECLARATIONS ]######################################################

  class-declarations:
    - match: class\b
      scope: meta.class.cs keyword.declaration.class.cs
      push:
        - class-block
        - class-base
        - class-parameter-list
        - type-parameter-list
        - class-declaration-name

  class-declaration-name:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.name.class.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  class-parameter-list:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-class-parameter-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-class-parameter-list:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.class.parameters.cs meta.group.cs
    - include: inside-method-parameter-list

  class-base:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      set: inside-class-base
    - match: (?=where\b)
      set: type-constraints
    - include: else-pop

  inside-class-base:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.class.base.cs
    - include: inherited-classes

  class-block:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.class.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-class-block
    - include: else-pop

  inside-class-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.class.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: statement-blocks
    - include: stray-punctuation
    - include: terminators
    # nested global declarations
    - include: class-declarations
    - include: enum-declarations
    - include: interface-declarations
    - include: record-declarations
    - include: struct-declarations
    - include: union-declarations
    - include: delegate-declarations
    # class level declarations
    - include: event-declarations
    - include: extension-declarations
    - include: conversion-declarations
    - include: constructor-declarations
    # declaration modifiers
    - include: attributes
    - include: modifiers
    - include: visibility
    # statements and expressions (fallback)
    - include: embedded-statements
    - include: label-declarations
    - include: member-declarations
    - include: else-expression

###[ ENUM DECLARATIONS ]#######################################################

  enum-declarations:
    - match: enum\b
      scope: meta.enum.cs keyword.declaration.enum.cs
      push:
        - enum-block
        - enum-base
        - enum-declaration-name

  enum-declaration-name:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.name.enum.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  enum-base:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      set: inside-enum-base
    - include: else-pop

  inside-enum-base:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.enum.base.cs
    - match: (?:byte|sbyte|short|ushort|int|uint|nint|nuint|long|ulong)\b
      scope: storage.type.primitive.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: '{{base_type}}'
      scope: invalid.illegal.type.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.other.inherited-class.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  enum-block:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.enum.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-enum-block
    - include: else-pop

  inside-enum-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.enum.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: attributes
    - include: separators
    - include: assignment-expressions
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.name.constant.cs
    - include: else-pop

###[ INTERFACE DECLARATIONS ]##################################################

  interface-declarations:
    - match: interface\b
      scope: meta.interface.cs keyword.declaration.interface.cs
      push:
        - interface-block
        - interface-base
        - type-parameter-list
        - interface-declaration-name

  interface-declaration-name:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.name.interface.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  interface-base:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      set: inside-interface-base
    - match: (?=where\b)
      set: type-constraints
    - include: else-pop

  inside-interface-base:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.interface.base.cs
    - include: inherited-classes

  interface-block:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.interface.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-interface-block
    - include: else-pop

  inside-interface-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.interface.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - include: inside-class-block

###[ RECORD DECLARATIONS ]#####################################################

  record-declarations:
    - match: record\b
      scope: meta.record.cs keyword.declaration.record.cs
      push:
        - record-block
        - record-base
        - record-parameter-list
        - type-parameter-list
        - record-name

  record-name:
    - match: struct\b
      scope: keyword.declaration.struct.cs
      set: struct-declaration-name
    - match: class\b
      scope: keyword.declaration.class.cs
      set: class-declaration-name
    - include: class-declaration-name

  record-parameter-list:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-record-parameter-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-record-parameter-list:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.record.parameters.cs meta.group.cs
    - include: inside-method-parameter-list

  record-base:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      set: inside-record-base
    - match: (?=where\b)
      set: type-constraints
    - include: else-pop

  inside-record-base:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.record.base.cs
    - include: inherited-classes

  record-block:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.record.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-record-block
    - include: else-pop

  inside-record-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.record.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - include: inside-class-block

###[ STRUCT DECLARATIONS ]#####################################################

  struct-declarations:
    - match: struct\b
      scope: meta.struct.cs keyword.declaration.struct.cs
      push:
        - struct-block
        - struct-base
        - struct-parameter-list
        - type-parameter-list
        - struct-declaration-name

  struct-declaration-name:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.name.struct.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  struct-parameter-list:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-struct-parameter-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-struct-parameter-list:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.struct.parameters.cs meta.group.cs
    - include: inside-method-parameter-list

  struct-base:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      set: inside-struct-base
    - match: (?=where\b)
      set: type-constraints
    - include: else-pop

  inside-struct-base:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.struct.base.cs
    - include: inherited-classes

  struct-block:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.struct.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-struct-block
    - include: else-pop

  inside-struct-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.struct.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - include: inside-class-block

###[ UNION DECLARATIONS ]######################################################

  union-declarations:
    - match: union\b
      scope: meta.union.cs keyword.declaration.union.cs
      push:
        - union-block
        - union-base
        - union-parameter-list
        - type-parameter-list
        - union-declaration-name

  union-declaration-name:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.name.union.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  union-parameter-list:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-union-parameter-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-union-parameter-list:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.union.parameters.cs meta.group.cs
    - include: inside-method-parameter-list

  union-base:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      set: inside-union-base
    - match: (?=where\b)
      set: type-constraints
    - include: else-pop

  inside-union-base:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.union.base.cs
    - include: inherited-classes

  union-block:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.union.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-union-block
    - include: else-pop

  inside-union-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.union.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - include: inside-class-block

###[ TYPE DECLARATION SIGNATURES ]#############################################

  inherited-classes:
    - match: (?=where\b)
      set: type-constraints
    - include: separators
    - include: accessors
    - include: namespace-variables
    - include: base-types
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}(?={{generic_declaration}}?\s*\.)'
      scope: support.type.cs
      push:
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.other.inherited-class.cs
      push:
        - inherited-class-argument-list
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - include: else-pop

  inherited-class-argument-list:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-inherited-class-argument-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-inherited-class-argument-list:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.constructor.arguments.cs meta.group.cs
    - include: inside-function-call-argument-list

  type-constraints:
    - meta_scope: meta.constraints.cs
    - match: (where)\b\s*({{unreserved_name}})?\s*(:)?
      captures:
        1: storage.modifier.where.cs
        2: support.type.cs
        3: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      push: primary-type-constraint
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.comma.cs
      push: secondary-type-constraint
    - include: else-pop

  primary-type-constraint:
    - match: (?:default|notnull|unmanaged)\b
      scope: storage.modifier.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: (?:class|struct)\b
      scope: storage.type.primitive.cs
      set:
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - include: secondary-type-constraint

  secondary-type-constraint:
    - match: (allows)\s+(ref)\s+(struct)\b
      captures:
        1: storage.modifier.cs
        2: storage.modifier.cs
        3: storage.type.primitive.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: (new)\s*((\()\s*(\)))
      scope: meta.constructor.cs
      captures:
        1: keyword.operator.new.cs
        2: meta.group.cs
        3: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
        4: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: maybe-object-type

###[ MEMBER DECLARATIONS ]#####################################################

  member-declarations:
    - match: (?=[(@]|{{start_char}})
      push:
        - member-name
        - maybe-type

  member-name:
    - include: member-qualifiers
    - include: method-declarator
    - include: indexer-declarator
    - include: operator-declarator
    - include: field-declarator
    - include: stray-names
    - include: else-pop

  member-qualifiers:
    - include: accessors
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}(?={{generic_declaration}}?\s*\.)'
      scope: entity.other.inherited-class.cs
      push:
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list

###[ CONSTRUCTOR MEMBER DECLARATIONS ]#########################################

  constructor-declarations:
    - match: '~{{unreserved_name}}(?=\s*\()'
      scope: meta.method.cs entity.name.function.destructor.cs
      push:
        - destructor-meta
        - method-body
        - method-parameter-list
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}(?=\s*\()'
      scope: meta.method.cs entity.name.function.constructor.cs
      push:
        - constructor-meta
        - method-body
        - constructor-initializer
        - method-parameter-list

  constructor-meta:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.constructor.cs
    - include: immediately-pop

  constructor-initializer:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      set: inside-constructor-initializer
    - include: else-pop

  inside-constructor-initializer:
    - match: ((?:(this)|(base))\s*)(\()
      captures:
        1: meta.initializer.cs
        2: variable.language.this.cs
        3: variable.language.super.cs
        4: meta.initializer.arguments.cs meta.group.cs punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-constructor-initializer-argument-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-constructor-initializer-argument-list:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.initializer.arguments.cs meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: meta.initializer.arguments.cs meta.group.cs punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: arguments

  destructor-meta:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.destructor.cs
    - include: immediately-pop

###[ DELEGATE MEMBER DECLARATIONS ]############################################

  delegate-declarations:
    - match: delegate\b(?!\s*\*)
      scope: meta.delegate.cs keyword.declaration.delegate.cs
      push:
        - delegate-parameter-list
        - type-parameter-list
        - delegate-declaration-name
        - maybe-type

  delegate-declaration-name:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: entity.name.type.delegate.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  delegate-parameter-list:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.delegate.cs
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-delegate-parameter-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-delegate-parameter-list:
    - meta_scope: meta.delegate.parameters.cs meta.group.cs
    - include: inside-method-parameter-list

###[ EVENT MEMBER DECLARATIONS ]###############################################

  event-declarations:
    - match: event\b
      scope: keyword.declaration.event.cs
      push:
        - event-declaration-meta
        - event-declaration-initializer
        - event-declaration-name
        - maybe-type

  event-declaration-meta:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.event.cs
    - include: immediately-pop

  event-declaration-name:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - include: member-qualifiers
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.other.member.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  event-declaration-initializer:
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-event-accessor-declaration
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: inside-field-declarations

  inside-event-accessor-declaration:
    - meta_scope: meta.accessors.cs meta.block.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: stray-punctuation
    - include: terminators
    - include: attributes
    - match: add\b
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.function.accessor.add.cs
      push: method-body
    - match: remove\b
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.function.accessor.remove.cs
      push: method-body
    - include: stray-names

###[ EXTENSION MEMBER DECLARATIONS ]###########################################

  extension-declarations:
    - match: extension\b
      scope: meta.extension.cs keyword.declaration.trait.cs
      push:
        - extension-block
        - extension-base
        - extension-parameter-list
        - type-parameter-list

  extension-parameter-list:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-extension-parameter-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-extension-parameter-list:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.extension.parameters.cs meta.group.cs
    - include: inside-method-parameter-list

  extension-base:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      set: inside-extension-base
    - match: (?=where\b)
      set: type-constraints
    - include: else-pop

  inside-extension-base:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.extension.base.cs
    - include: inherited-classes

  extension-block:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.extension.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-extension-block
    - include: else-pop

  inside-extension-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.extension.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - include: inside-class-block

###[ FIELD MEMBER DECLARATIONS ]###############################################

  field-declarator:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.other.member.cs
      set:
        - field-meta
        - field-body

  field-meta:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.field.cs
    - include: immediately-pop

  field-body:
    # property
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set:
        - maybe-assignment-expression
        - inside-field-accessor-declaration
    - match: =>
      scope: keyword.declaration.function.accessor.get.cs
      set:
        - expression
        - maybe-pointer
    # field
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: inside-field-declarations

  inside-field-accessor-declaration:
    - meta_scope: meta.accessors.cs meta.block.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: stray-punctuation
    - include: terminators
    - include: attributes
    - include: visibility
    - match: readonly\b
      scope: storage.modifier.cs
    - match: init\b
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.function.accessor.init.cs
      push: method-body
    - match: get\b
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.function.accessor.get.cs
      push: method-body
    - match: set\b
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.function.accessor.set.cs
      push: method-body
    - include: stray-names

  inside-field-declarations:
    - include: member-qualifiers
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.other.member.cs
    - include: separators
    - include: assignment-expressions
    - include: else-pop

###[ INDEXER DECLARATIONS ]####################################################

  indexer-declarator:
    - match: this\b
      scope: meta.indexer.cs variable.language.this.cs
      set:
        - indexer-body
        - indexer-parameter-list

  indexer-parameter-list:
    - match: \[
      scope: punctuation.section.brackets.begin.cs
      set: inside-indexer-parameter-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-indexer-parameter-list:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.indexer.parameters.cs meta.brackets.cs
    - match: \]
      scope: punctuation.section.brackets.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: method-parameters

  indexer-body:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.indexer.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-indexer-accessor-declaration
    - match: =>
      scope: meta.indexer.cs keyword.declaration.function.accessor.get.cs
      set:
        - indexer-expression
        - maybe-pointer
    - include: else-pop

  inside-indexer-accessor-declaration:
    - meta_scope: meta.indexer.cs meta.accessors.cs meta.block.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: stray-punctuation
    - include: terminators
    - include: attributes
    - include: visibility
    - match: get\b
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.function.accessor.get.cs
      push: method-body
    - match: set\b
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.function.accessor.set.cs
      push: method-body
    - include: stray-names

  indexer-expression:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.indexer.body.cs
    - include: expression

###[ METHOD MEMBER DECLARATIONS ]##############################################

  method-declarator:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}(?={{generic_declaration}}?\s*\()'
      scope: meta.method.cs entity.name.function.cs
      set:
        - method-body
        - method-parameter-list
        - type-parameter-list

  method-parameter-list:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-method-parameter-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-method-parameter-list:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.method.parameters.cs meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: method-parameters

  method-parameters:
    - include: separators
    - match: (?=[;{}]|=>)
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=\S)
      push:
        - maybe-assignment-expression
        - method-param-name
        - maybe-type
        - method-param-modifier

  method-param-modifier:
    - include: attributes
    - match: '{{method_param_type_modifier}}'
      scope: storage.modifier.parameter.cs
    - include: else-pop

  method-param-name:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.parameter.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  method-body:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.method.cs
    - match: (?=where\b)
      push: type-constraints
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-method-block
    - match: =>
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.function.arrow.cs
      set:
        - inside-method-expression
        - maybe-pointer
    - include: else-pop

  inside-method-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.method.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - include: inside-statement-block

  inside-method-expression:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.method.body.cs
    - include: expression

###[ OPERATOR DECLARATIONS ]###################################################

  conversion-declarations:
    - match: operator\b
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.operator.cs
      push:
        - method-body
        - method-parameter-list
        - maybe-object-type

  operator-declarator:
    - match: operator\b
      scope: meta.method.cs keyword.declaration.operator.cs
      set:
        - method-body
        - method-parameter-list
        - operator-name

  operator-name:
    # overloadable unary and binary operators
    - match: (?:\+\+|--|<<|>>>?|<=?|>=?|==|!=|[-+*/%&|^~!]|false|true)(?=[\s(])
      scope: entity.name.function.cs
      pop: 1
    # illegal operator tokens
    - match: '[^\s(};]+'
      scope: invalid.illegal.operator.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

###[ VARIABLE DECLARATIONS ]###################################################

  local-declarations:
    - match: (delegate)\s*(\*)
      captures:
        1: keyword.declaration.delegate.cs
        2: keyword.operator.pointer.cs
      push:
        - expression-list
        - funcptr-type-meta
        - type-argument-list
        - funcptr-type-modifier
    - match: var\b
      scope: storage.type.variant.cs
      push:
        - maybe-assignment-expression
        - var-declarator
    - match: '{{base_type}}'
      scope: storage.type.primitive.cs
      push:
        - local-declarator
        - type-suffix
    - match: (?={{namespaced_name}}\s+{{name}})
      push:
        - local-declarator
        - maybe-type

  local-declarator:
    - include: method-declarator
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: expression-list

  var-declaration:
    - match: var\b
      scope: storage.type.variant.cs
      set: var-declarator
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: [variable-declaration-name, maybe-type]

  var-declarator:
    - include: tuple-literal
    - include: variable-declaration-name

  variable-declaration-name:
    - match: _\b
      scope: variable.language.anonymous.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.other.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

###[ STATEMENTS ]##############################################################

  maybe-statement-block:
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-statement-block
    - include: else-pop

  statement-blocks:
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      push: inside-statement-block

  inside-statement-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.block.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: stray-punctuation
    - include: terminators
    - include: statement-blocks
    - include: embedded-statements
    - include: local-declarations
    - include: label-declarations
    - include: else-expression

  embedded-statements:
    # conditional statements
    - match: else\s+if\b
      scope: keyword.control.conditional.elseif.cs
      push: maybe-expression-group
    - match: else\b
      scope: keyword.control.conditional.else.cs
    - match: if\b
      scope: keyword.control.conditional.if.cs
      push: maybe-expression-group
    - match: switch\b
      scope: keyword.control.conditional.switch.cs
      push: maybe-expression-group
    - match: case\b
      scope: meta.case.cs keyword.control.conditional.case.cs
      push:
        - case-pattern
        - expect-pattern
    - match: ((default)\s*)({{colon}})
      captures:
        1: meta.case.pattern.cs
        2: keyword.control.conditional.default.cs
        3: meta.case.cs punctuation.separator.colon.cs
    # exception statements
    - match: catch\b
      scope: keyword.control.exception.catch.cs
      push:
        - catch-guard
        - catch-group
    - match: finally\b
      scope: keyword.control.exception.finally.cs
    - match: try\b
      scope: keyword.control.exception.try.cs
    # loop statements
    - match: do\b
      scope: keyword.control.loop.do.cs
    - match: foreach\b
      scope: keyword.control.loop.foreach.cs
      push: foreach-group
    - match: for\b
      scope: keyword.control.loop.for.cs
      push: for-group
    - match: while\b
      scope: keyword.control.loop.while.cs
      push: maybe-expression-group
    # control flow statements
    - match: (?:break|yield\s+break)\b
      scope: keyword.control.flow.break.cs
    - match: continue\b
      scope: keyword.control.flow.continue.cs
    - match: goto\b
      scope: keyword.control.flow.goto.cs
      push: goto-target
    - match: lock\b
      scope: keyword.control.flow.lock.cs
      push: maybe-expression-group
    # declarations
    - match: fixed\b
      scope: keyword.declaration.fixed.cs
      push: fixed-group
    - match: using\b
      scope: keyword.declaration.using.cs
      push: using-body
    # reserved expression keywords
    - include: keywords

  goto-target:
    - match: case\b
      scope: keyword.control.conditional.case.cs
      set: expression
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: constant.other.label.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  label-declarations:
    - match: ({{name}})\s*({{colon}})
      captures:
        1: entity.name.label.cs
        2: punctuation.separator.colon.cs

###[ CONDITIONAL STATEMENTS ]##################################################

  case-pattern:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.case.pattern.cs
    - match: \bwhen\b
      scope: meta.case.guard.cs keyword.control.conditional.when.cs
      set: inside-case-guard
    - include: inside-case-guard

  inside-case-guard:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.case.guard.cs
    - match: '{{colon}}'
      scope: meta.case.cs punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: expression

###[ EXCEPTION STATEMENTS ]####################################################

  catch-group:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - catch-group-end
        - var-declaration
    - include: else-pop

  catch-group-end:
    - meta_scope: meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  catch-guard:
    - match: when\b
      scope: keyword.control.conditional.when.cs
      set: maybe-expression-group
    - include: else-pop

###[ FIXED STATEMENTS ]########################################################

  fixed-group:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-fixed-group
        - var-declaration
    - include: else-pop

  inside-fixed-group:
    - meta_scope: meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: expression-list

###[ FOR STATEMENTS ]##########################################################

  for-group:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - for-iteration
        - for-separator
        - expression
        - for-separator
        - expression-list
        - for-declaration
    - include: else-pop

  for-declaration:
    - match: (?={{namespaced_name}}\s+{{name}})
      set: var-declaration
    - include: else-pop

  for-separator:
    - match: ';'
      scope: punctuation.terminator.statement.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  for-iteration:
    - meta_scope: meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: expression-list

  foreach-group:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-expression-group
        - foreach-in
        - var-declaration
    - include: else-pop

  foreach-in:
    - match: in\b
      scope: keyword.control.loop.in.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

###[ USING STATEMENTS ]########################################################

  using-body:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-using-group
        - var-declaration
    - match: (?=\S)
      set:
        - expression-list
        - var-declaration

  inside-using-group:
    - meta_scope: meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: expression-list

###[ EXPRESSIONS ]#############################################################

  expression-list:
    - include: separators
    - include: expression

  else-expression:
    - match: (?=\S)
      push:
        - expression
        - maybe-pointer

  expression:
    - include: parens
    - include: lambdas
    - include: expression-common
    - include: else-pop

  expression-common:
    - match: \[
      scope: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.begin.cs
      push:
        - inside-item-access
        - maybe-pointer
    # accessors and operators (Note: order matters!)
    - match: ->
      scope: punctuation.accessor.arrow.cs
      push: maybe-pointer
    - match: '(?x: << | >>>? | \?\? | [-+*/%|&^] )='
      scope: keyword.operator.assignment.augmented.cs
      push: maybe-pointer
    - match: '(?x: \+\+? | --? | [*/%] )'
      scope: keyword.operator.arithmetic.cs
      push: maybe-pointer
    - match: '(?x: && | \|\| | !(?!=) )'
      scope: keyword.operator.logical.cs
      push: maybe-pointer
    - match: '(?x: << | >>>? | [|&^~] )'
      scope: keyword.operator.bitwise.cs
      push: maybe-pointer
    - match: '(?x: <=? | >=? | == | != )'
      scope: keyword.operator.comparison.cs
      push: maybe-pointer
    - match: =
      scope: keyword.operator.assignment.cs
      push: assignment-value
    - match: \.\.
      scope: keyword.operator.range.cs
      push: maybe-pointer
    - match: (\?)?(\.)
      captures:
        1: keyword.operator.null-coalescing.cs
        2: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
      push: maybe-pointer
    - match: \?\?
      scope: keyword.operator.null-coalescing.cs
    - match: (?=\?)
      branch_point: null-coalescing
      branch:
        - null-coalescing
        - ternary-expression
    # keywords
    - match: '{{sql_keywords}}'
      scope: keyword.other.sql.cs
    - include: keywords
    - include: switch-expressions
    - include: base-types
    - include: constants
    - match: (?={{statement_keywords}}|{{visibility}})
      pop: 1
    # literals
    - include: characters
    - include: numbers
    - include: strings
    # language variables
    - match: _\b
      scope: variable.language.anonymous.cs
    - match: field\b
      scope: variable.language.cs
    - match: value\b
      scope: variable.language.cs
    - include: namespace-variables
    # expressions
    - match: (?:(?:(?:(System)(\.))?(Text)(\.))?(RegularExpressions)(\.))?(Regex)(\.)(Match|IsMatch|Replace)(?=\s*\()
      captures:
        1: variable.other.cs
        2: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
        3: variable.other.cs
        4: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
        5: variable.other.cs
        6: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
        7: support.type.cs
        8: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
        9: meta.function-call.identifier.cs variable.function.cs
      push: regex-function-call-argument-list
    - match: '{{name}}(?={{generic_declaration}}?{{item_access}}*\s*\()'
      scope: meta.function-call.identifier.cs variable.function.cs
      push:
        - maybe-item-access
        - function-call-argument-list
        - maybe-item-access
        - type-argument-list
    - match: '{{name}}(?={{generic_declaration}})'
      scope: support.type.cs
      push:
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - match: '{{name}}'
      scope: variable.other.cs
      push: maybe-item-access
    - match: '@'
      scope: invalid.illegal.reserved-char.cs

  null-coalescing:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \?
      scope: keyword.operator.null-coalescing.cs
      set: null-coalescing-item-access
    - include: immediately-pop

  null-coalescing-item-access:
    - match: \[
      scope: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.begin.cs
      set:
        - null-coalescing-item-access-check
        - inside-item-access
        - maybe-pointer
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: null-coalescing

  null-coalescing-item-access-check:
    - match: (?=:)
      fail: null-coalescing
    - include: else-pop

  ternary-expression:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \?
      scope: keyword.operator.ternary.cs
      set: inside-ternary-expression
    - include: immediately-pop

  inside-ternary-expression:
    - match: ':'
      scope: keyword.operator.ternary.cs
      set: expression
    - include: expression

  keywords:
    - include: instantiations
    - include: modifiers
    - match: delegate\b(?!\s*\*)
      scope: meta.function.anonymous.cs keyword.declaration.delegate.cs
      push:
        - delegate-lambda-body
        - delegate-lambda-parameter-list
    - match: this\b
      scope: variable.language.this.cs
      push:
        - maybe-member-access
        - maybe-item-access
    - match: base\b
      scope: variable.language.super.cs
      push:
        - maybe-member-access
        - maybe-item-access
    - match: await\b
      scope: keyword.control.flow.await.cs
    - match: (?:return|yield\s+return)\b
      scope: keyword.control.flow.return.cs
      push: expression
    - match: throw\b
      scope: keyword.control.flow.throw.cs
      push: expression
    - match: (?:and|not|or)\b
      scope: keyword.operator.logical.cs
    - match: (?:checked|unchecked)\b
      scope: keyword.other.cs
      push: maybe-expression-group
    - match: as\b
      scope: keyword.operator.cast.cs
      push: maybe-type
    - match: is\b
      scope: keyword.operator.comparison.type.cs
      push: expect-pattern
    - match: nameof\b
      scope: keyword.other.cs
      push: maybe-nameof-group
    - match: (?:sizeof|typeof|default)\b
      scope: keyword.other.cs
      push: maybe-type-group

###[ ASSIGNMENT EXPRESSIONS ]##################################################

  maybe-assignment-expression:
    - match: \s*(=)
      captures:
        1: keyword.operator.assignment.cs
      set: assignment-value
    - include: noeol-pop

  assignment-expressions:
    - match: =
      scope: keyword.operator.assignment.cs
      push: assignment-value

  assignment-value:
    - match: (?=\[)
      branch_point: array-initializer
      branch:
        - array-initializer
        - annotated-expression
      pop: 1
    - match: \{
      scope: meta.braces.cs punctuation.section.braces.begin.cs
      set: inside-variable-initializer
    - match: (?=\S)
      set:
        - expression
        - maybe-pointer

  array-initializer:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \[
      scope: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.begin.cs
      set:
        - check-array-initializer
        - inside-array-initializer
        - maybe-pointer
        - maybe-array-with-arguments

  maybe-array-with-arguments:
    - match: with\b
      scope: meta.function-call.identifier.cs keyword.other.with.cs
      set: function-call-argument-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-array-initializer:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.brackets.cs
    - match: \]
      scope: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: expression-list

  check-array-initializer:
    - match: (?=[,;)\]}])
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: array-initializer

  annotated-expression:
    - include: attributes
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: expression

###[ COMMON PARENTHESIZED EXPRESSIONS ]########################################

  parens:
    - match: (?=\()
      branch_point: parens
      branch:
        - paren-lambda
        - paren-tuple-deconstruction
        - paren-cast
        - paren-group
        - paren-tuple-type
        - tuple-literal

  paren-cast:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - paren-cast-operand
        - paren-cast-end
        - maybe-type

  paren-cast-end:
    - meta_scope: meta.cast.cs meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: parens

  paren-cast-operand:
    - include: cast-end
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: parens

  cast-end:
    # cast expressions may be followed by:
    # - `(`     : cast, lambda, tuple or group expression
    # - `!`     : unary operator
    # - `~`     : unary operator
    # - `--`    : unary operator
    # - `++`    : unary operator
    # - literal : char, digit, string, variable, type or method
    - match: (?=(?!and|not|or|as|is|switch\b){{start_char}}|[!~(\d"']|--|\+\+)
      pop: 1

  paren-group:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - paren-group-end
        - expression
        - maybe-pointer

  paren-group-end:
    - meta_scope: meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: parens

  paren-lambda:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-paren-lambda-parameter-list

  inside-paren-lambda-parameter-list:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.anonymous.parameters.cs meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      set: paren-lambda-body
    - include: attributes
    - include: separators
    - match: '{{method_param_type_modifier}}\b'
      scope: storage.modifier.parameter.cs
    - match: '{{name}}(?=\s*[,)])'
      scope: variable.parameter.cs
    - match: var\b
      scope: storage.type.variant.cs
      push: method-param-name
    - match: (?=[@(]|{{start_char}})
      push:
        - method-param-name
        - maybe-type
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: parens

  paren-lambda-body:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.function.anonymous.cs
    - match: =>
      scope: meta.function.anonymous.cs keyword.declaration.function.arrow.cs
      set: lambda-body
    - match: (?=\{)
      set: lambda-body
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: parens

  paren-tuple-deconstruction:
    # (type name, name, name) =
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.sequence.begin.cs
      set:
        - paren-tuple-deconstruction-operator
        - inside-paren-tuple-deconstruction

  inside-paren-tuple-deconstruction:
    - meta_scope: meta.sequence.tuple.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.sequence.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: separators
    - match: _\b
      scope: variable.language.anonymous.cs
    - match: var\b
      scope: storage.type.variant.cs
      push: var-declarator
    - match: (?={{namespaced_name}}\s*[,)])
      push: variable-declaration-name
    - match: (?=[@(]|{{start_char}})
      push:
        - variable-declaration-name
        - maybe-type
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: parens

  paren-tuple-deconstruction-operator:
    - match: (?==)
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: parens

  paren-tuple-type:
    # (type name, type, type) func()
    # (type name, type, type) variable
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.sequence.begin.cs
      set:
        - paren-tuple-type-operand
        - type-suffix
        - inside-type-tuple

  paren-tuple-type-operand:
    - include: method-declarator
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.other.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: parens

  tuple-literal:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.sequence.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-tuple-literal
        - maybe-pointer

  inside-tuple-literal:
    - meta_scope: meta.sequence.tuple.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.sequence.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: member-variables
    - include: expression-list

###[ GROUP EXPRESSIONS ]#######################################################

  maybe-expression-group:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-expression-group
        - maybe-pointer
    - include: else-pop

  inside-expression-group:
    - meta_scope: meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: expression

  maybe-nameof-group:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-nameof-group
        - maybe-pointer
    - include: else-pop

  inside-nameof-group:
    - meta_scope: meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: accessors
    - include: namespace-variables
    - include: instance-variables
    - include: base-types
    # It is not possible to distinguish types and variables syntactically.
    # Hence assume uppercase names to be types, and all remaining ones to be
    # variables.
    - match: '{{lower_name}}(?=\s*\))'
      scope: variable.other.cs
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: support.type.cs
      push:
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - include: stray-names
    - include: else-pop

  maybe-type-group:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - type-group-end
        - maybe-type
    - include: else-pop

  type-group-end:
    - meta_scope: meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: stray-names
    - include: else-pop

###[ FUNCTION CALL EXPRESSIONS ]###############################################

  regex-function-call-argument-list:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.function-call.identifier.cs
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-regex-function-call-argument-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-regex-function-call-argument-list:
    - meta_scope: meta.function-call.arguments.cs meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=[@$]*")
      push: regex-string
    - include: arguments

  function-call-argument-list:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.function-call.identifier.cs
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-function-call-argument-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-function-call-argument-list:
    - meta_scope: meta.function-call.arguments.cs meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: arguments

  arguments:
    - match: out\b
      scope: storage.modifier.argument.cs
      push: out-argument
    - match: ref\b
      scope: storage.modifier.argument.cs
    - match: ({{name}})\s*({{colon}}|{{equal}})
      captures:
        1: variable.parameter.cs
        2: keyword.operator.assignment.cs
      push: assignment-value
    - include: expression-list

  out-argument:
    - match: ref\b
      scope: storage.modifier.argument.cs
    - match: (?={{namespaced_name}}\s+{{name}})
      set: var-declaration
    - include: else-pop

###[ INSTANTIATION EXPRESSIONS ]###############################################

  instantiations:
    - match: new\b
      scope: keyword.operator.new.cs
      push:
        - instantiation-meta
        - maybe-variable-initializer
        - instantiation-type
    - match: stackalloc\b
      scope: keyword.operator.stackalloc.cs
      push:
        - instantiation-meta
        - maybe-variable-initializer
        - instantiation-type
    - match: with(?=\s*\{)
      scope: keyword.operator.with.cs
      push: maybe-variable-initializer

  instantiation-meta:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.instantiation.cs
    - include: immediately-pop

  instantiation-type:
    - match: (?:(?:(?:(System)(\.))?(Text)(\.))?(RegularExpressions)(\.))?(Regex)\b
      captures:
        1: variable.other.cs
        2: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
        3: variable.other.cs
        4: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
        5: variable.other.cs
        6: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
        7: meta.function-call.identifier.cs support.type.cs
      set: regex-function-call-argument-list
    - match: (?=\S)
      set:
        - function-call-argument-list
        - maybe-object-type

  maybe-variable-initializer:
    # collection or object initializer
    - match: \s*(\{)
      captures:
        1: meta.braces.cs punctuation.section.braces.begin.cs
      set: inside-variable-initializer
    - include: noeol-pop

  inside-variable-initializer:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.braces.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: meta.braces.cs punctuation.section.braces.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: \{
      scope: meta.braces.cs punctuation.section.braces.begin.cs
      push: inside-variable-initializer
    - match: ({{name}})\s*({{equal}})
      captures:
        1: variable.other.member.cs
        2: keyword.operator.assignment.cs
      push: maybe-pointer
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}(?=<)'
      scope: support.type.cs
      push:
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - match: (\?)?(\.)
      captures:
        1: keyword.operator.null-coalescing.cs
        2: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
      push: member-access
    - include: expression-list

###[ ITEM ACCESS EXPRESSIONS ]#################################################

  maybe-item-access:
    - match: \s*(\[)
      captures:
        1: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.begin.cs
      push:
        - inside-item-access
        - maybe-pointer
    - include: noeol-pop

  inside-item-access:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.brackets.cs
    - match: \]
      scope: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: member-variables
    - include: expression-list

  maybe-member-access:
    - match: \s*(\?)?(\.)
      captures:
        1: keyword.operator.null-coalescing.cs
        2: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
      set: member-access
    - include: noeol-pop

  member-access:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}(?={{generic_declaration}}?{{item_access}}*\s*\()'
      scope: meta.function-call.identifier.cs variable.function.cs
      set:
        - maybe-member-access
        - maybe-item-access
        - function-call-argument-list
        - maybe-item-access
        - type-argument-list
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}(?={{generic_declaration}})'
      scope: support.type.cs
      set:
        - maybe-member-access
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.other.member.cs
      set:
        - maybe-member-access
        - maybe-item-access
    - include: else-pop

###[ LAMBDA EXPRESSIONS ]######################################################

  delegate-lambda-parameter-list:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set: inside-delegate-lambda-parameter-list
    - include: else-pop

  inside-delegate-lambda-parameter-list:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.function.anonymous.parameters.cs meta.group.cs
    - include: inside-method-parameter-list

  delegate-lambda-body:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.function.anonymous.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-lambda-block
        - maybe-pointer
    - include: else-pop

  lambdas:
    - match: ({{name}})(\s+(=>))
      captures:
        1: meta.function.anonymous.parameters.cs variable.parameter.cs
        2: meta.function.anonymous.cs
        3: keyword.declaration.function.arrow.cs
      push: lambda-body

  lambda-body:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.function.anonymous.cs
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-lambda-block
        - maybe-pointer
    - match: (?=\S)
      set:
        - inside-lambda-expression
        - maybe-pointer

  inside-lambda-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.anonymous.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - include: inside-statement-block

  inside-lambda-expression:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.function.anonymous.body.cs
    - include: expression

###[ SWITCH EXPRESSIONS ]######################################################

  switch-expressions:
    - match: switch\b
      scope: keyword.control.conditional.switch.cs
      push: switch-expression-block

  switch-expression-block:
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-switch-expression-block
        - switch-expression-case-pattern
        - expect-pattern
    - include: else-pop

  inside-switch-expression-block:
    - meta_scope: meta.block.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.comma.cs
      push:
        - switch-expression-case-pattern
        - expect-pattern
    - include: expression

  switch-expression-case-pattern:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.case.pattern.cs
    - match: when\b
      scope: meta.case.guard.cs keyword.control.conditional.when.cs
      set: inside-switch-expression-case-guard
    - include: inside-switch-expression-case-guard

  inside-switch-expression-case-guard:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.case.guard.cs
    - match: =>
      scope: meta.case.cs punctuation.separator.case-expression.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: switch-expression-case-guard-expression

  switch-expression-case-guard-expression:
    - match: (?=\()
      branch_point: switch-expression-case-guard-parens
      branch:
        - switch-expression-case-guard-cast
        - switch-expression-case-guard-group
        - tuple-literal
    - include: expression-common
    - include: else-pop

  switch-expression-case-guard-cast:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - after-switch-expression-case-guard-cast
        - inside-switch-expression-case-guard-cast
        - maybe-type

  inside-switch-expression-case-guard-cast:
    - meta_scope: meta.cast.cs meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: switch-expression-case-guard-parens

  after-switch-expression-case-guard-cast:
    - include: cast-end
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: switch-expression-case-guard-parens

  switch-expression-case-guard-group:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-switch-expression-case-guard-group
        - switch-expression-case-guard-expression
        - maybe-pointer

  inside-switch-expression-case-guard-group:
    - meta_scope: meta.group.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.group.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: switch-expression-case-guard-parens

###[ TYPE PATTERNS ]###########################################################

  expect-pattern:
    - include: tuple-literal
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-member-pattern
    - match: not\b
      scope: keyword.operator.logical.cs
    - match: var\b
      scope: storage.type.variant.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: '{{base_type}}'
      scope: storage.type.primitive.cs
      set:
        - maybe-member-pattern
        - maybe-member-access
        - type-suffix
    - match: '{{cap_name}}'
      scope: support.type.cs
      set:
        - maybe-member-pattern
        - maybe-member-access
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - include: else-pop

  maybe-member-pattern:
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.cs
      set: inside-member-pattern
    - include: else-pop

  inside-member-pattern:
    - meta_scope: meta.class.body.cs meta.block.cs
    - match: \}
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: separators
    - match: ({{name}})\s*(\.)
      captures:
        1: variable.other.member.cs
        2: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
    - match: ({{name}})\s*({{colon}})?
      captures:
        1: variable.other.member.cs
        2: keyword.operator.assignment.cs
      push:
        - expression
        - expect-pattern

###[ TYPES ]###################################################################

  modifiers:
    - match: '{{modifiers}}'
      scope: storage.modifier.cs

  visibility:
    - match: '{{visibility}}'
      scope: storage.modifier.access.cs
    - match: file\b  # soft keyword
      scope: storage.modifier.access.cs

  base-types:
    - match: '{{base_type}}'
      scope: storage.type.primitive.cs
      push:
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list

  maybe-type:
    - include: type-tuple
    - include: maybe-object-type

  maybe-object-type:
    - include: namespace-variables
    - match: (delegate)\s*(\*)
      captures:
        1: keyword.declaration.delegate.cs
        2: keyword.operator.pointer.cs
      set:
        - funcptr-type-meta
        - type-argument-list
        - funcptr-type-modifier
    - match: '{{base_type}}'
      scope: storage.type.primitive.cs
      set:
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: support.type.cs
      set:
        - maybe-type-accessor
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - match: \[
      scope: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.begin.cs
      push: inside-rank-specifier
    - include: else-pop

  maybe-type-accessor:
    - match: \s*(\.)
      captures:
        1: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
      set: maybe-user-type
    - include: noeol-pop

  maybe-user-type:
    - match: \s*({{unreserved_name}})
      captures:
        1: support.type.cs
      set:
        - maybe-type-accessor
        - type-suffix
        - type-argument-list
    - include: noeol-pop

  type-tuple:
    - match: \(
      scope: punctuation.section.sequence.begin.cs
      set:
        - type-suffix
        - inside-type-tuple

  inside-type-tuple:
    - meta_scope: meta.sequence.tuple.cs
    - match: \)
      scope: punctuation.section.sequence.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: separators
    - match: (?=\S)
      push: var-declaration

###[ TYPE PARAMETER LISTS ]####################################################

  type-argument-list:
    - match: \s*(<)
      captures:
        1: meta.generic.cs punctuation.definition.generic.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-type-argument-list
        - maybe-type
        - type-param-modifier
    - include: noeol-pop

  inside-type-argument-list:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.generic.cs
    - match: '>'
      scope: meta.generic.cs punctuation.definition.generic.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.comma.cs
      push:
        - maybe-type
        - type-param-modifier
    - include: else-pop

  type-parameter-list:
    - match: \s*(<)
      captures:
        1: meta.generic.cs punctuation.definition.generic.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-type-parameter-list
        - type-suffix
        - type-param-name
        - type-param-modifier
    - include: noeol-pop

  inside-type-parameter-list:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.generic.cs
    - match: '>'
      scope: meta.generic.cs punctuation.definition.generic.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.comma.cs
      push:
        - type-suffix
        - type-param-name
        - type-param-modifier
    - include: else-pop

  type-param-modifier:
    - include: attributes
    - match: '{{generic_param_type_modifier}}'
      scope: storage.modifier.cs
    - include: else-pop

  type-param-name:
    - match: '{{unreserved_name}}'
      scope: variable.parameter.type.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  type-suffix:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \s*(\?)
      captures:
        1: storage.modifier.nullable.cs
      set: inside-type-suffix
    - include: inside-type-suffix

  inside-type-suffix:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - match: \s*(\*)
      captures:
        1: keyword.operator.pointer.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: \s*(\[)
      scope: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.begin.cs
      push: inside-rank-specifier
    - include: noeol-pop

  inside-rank-specifier:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.brackets.cs
    - match: \]
      scope: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: expression-list

###[ FUNCTION POINTER TYPES ]##################################################

  funcptr-type-meta:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.type.funcptr.cs
    - include: immediately-pop

  funcptr-type-modifier:
    - match: \s*(managed)\b
      captures:
        1: storage.modifier.delegate.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: \s*(unmanaged)\b
      captures:
        1: storage.modifier.delegate.cs
      set: funcptr-type-calling-convention
    - include: noeol-pop

  funcptr-type-calling-convention:
    - match: \s*(\[)
      captures:
        1: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.begin.cs
      set:
        - inside-funcptr-type-calling-convention
        - maybe-type
        - funcptr-convention-modifier
    - include: noeol-pop

  inside-funcptr-type-calling-convention:
    - meta_content_scope: meta.brackets.cs
    - match: \]
      scope: meta.brackets.cs punctuation.section.brackets.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.comma.cs
      push:
        - maybe-type
        - funcptr-convention-modifier
    - include: else-pop

  funcptr-convention-modifier:
    - match: (?:Cdecl|Stdcall|Thiscall|Fastcall)\b
      scope: storage.modifier.funcptr.cs
    - include: attributes
    - include: else-pop

###[ OPERATORS ]###############################################################

  maybe-pointer:
    - match: '[*&]'
      scope: keyword.operator.pointer.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: else-pop

  accessors:
    - match: \.
      scope: punctuation.accessor.dot.cs
      push: maybe-pointer

  separators:
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.comma.cs

  terminators:
    - match: ';'
      scope: punctuation.terminator.statement.cs

  stray-punctuation:
    - match: '[]}),:]'
      scope: invalid.illegal.stray.cs

###[ VARIABLES ]###############################################################

  instance-variables:
    - match: this\b
      scope: variable.language.this.cs
    - match: base\b
      scope: variable.language.super.cs

  member-variables:
    - match: ({{name}})\s*({{colon}})
      captures:
        1: variable.other.member.cs
        2: keyword.operator.assignment.cs
      push: assignment-value

  namespace-variables:
    - match: (?:(global)|({{name}}))\s*(::)
      captures:
        1: support.namespace.global.cs
        2: variable.namespace.cs
        3: punctuation.accessor.double-colon.namespace.cs

  stray-names:
    - match: '{{name}}'
      scope: invalid.illegal.unexpected-token.cs

###[ LITERALS ]################################################################

  characters:
    - match: (')(?:({{escape_base}})|({{escape_hex}})|({{escape_uni16}})|({{escape_uni32}})|([^'\\]))(')
      scope: meta.string.cs string.quoted.single.cs
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
        2: constant.character.escape.cs
        3: constant.character.escape.hex.cs
        4: constant.character.escape.unicode.16bit.cs
        5: constant.character.escape.unicode.32bit.cs
        6: constant.character.literal.cs
        7: punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
    - match: \'.*\'
      scope: invalid.illegal.character.cs

  constants:
    - match: false\b
      scope: constant.language.boolean.false.cs
    - match: true\b
      scope: constant.language.boolean.true.cs
    - match: null\b
      scope: constant.language.null.cs

  numbers:
    - match: (0[xX])([\h_]*\h)({{integer_suffix}})?
      scope: meta.number.integer.hexadecimal.cs
      captures:
        1: constant.numeric.base.cs
        2: constant.numeric.value.cs
        3: constant.numeric.suffix.cs
    - match: (0[bB])([01_]*[01])({{integer_suffix}})?
      scope: meta.number.integer.binary.cs
      captures:
        1: constant.numeric.base.cs
        2: constant.numeric.value.cs
        3: constant.numeric.suffix.cs
    - match: (\d{{dec_digits}}?)(?:(?:((\.){{dec_digits}})({{dec_exponent}})?|({{dec_exponent}}))({{float_suffix}})?|({{float_suffix}}))
      scope: meta.number.float.decimal.cs
      captures:
        1: constant.numeric.value.cs
        2: constant.numeric.value.cs
        3: punctuation.separator.decimal.cs
        4: constant.numeric.value.exponent.cs
        5: constant.numeric.value.exponent.cs
        6: constant.numeric.suffix.cs
        7: constant.numeric.suffix.cs
    - match: (\d{{dec_digits}}?)({{integer_suffix}})?
      scope: meta.number.integer.decimal.cs
      captures:
        1: constant.numeric.value.cs
        2: constant.numeric.suffix.cs

###[ REGULAR EXPRESSIONS ]#####################################################

  regex-string:
    # literal raw literal string
    - match: ("""+)
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      set: inside-raw-string
    # literal quoted regexp string
    - match: '"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      set: inside-literal-regex-string
    # interpolated raw format strings
    - match: \${1}("""+)
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      set: inside-raw-format-string-1
    - match: \${2}("""+)
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      set: inside-raw-format-string-2
    - match: \${3}("""+)
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      set: inside-raw-format-string-3
    - match: \${4}("""+)
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      set: inside-raw-format-string-4
    # interpolated quoted format strings
    - match: \$"
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      set: inside-format-string
    # Verbatim regexp string
    - match: '@"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      set: inside-verbatim-regex-string
    # interpolated verbatim format strings
    - match: (?:@\$|\$@)"
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      set: inside-verbatim-format-string-syntax
    - include: else-pop

  inside-literal-regex-string:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.regexp.cs string.quoted.double.cs
    - meta_content_scope: source.regexp.embedded.cs
    - match: '"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: $\n?
      scope: invalid.illegal.unclosed-string.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: scope:source.regexp.embedded.cs.literal-string
      apply_prototype: true

  inside-verbatim-regex-string:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.regexp.cs string.quoted.double.verbatim.cs
    - meta_content_scope: source.regexp.embedded.cs
    - match: '"(?!")'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: scope:source.regexp.embedded.cs.verbatim-string
      apply_prototype: true

###[ STRINGS ]#################################################################

  strings:
    # literal raw strings
    - match: '(""""+)'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-raw-string
    - match: '"""'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-triple-quoted-raw-string-syntax
    # literal quoted strings
    - match: '"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-string
    # interpolated raw format strings
    - match: '\${1}("""+)'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-raw-format-string-1
    - match: '\${2}("""+)'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-raw-format-string-2
    - match: '\${3}("""+)'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-raw-format-string-3
    - match: '\${4}("""+)'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-raw-format-string-4
    # interpolated quoted format strings
    - match: '\$"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-format-string
    # literal verbatim strings
    - match: '@"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-verbatim-string-syntax
    # interpolated verbatim format strings
    - match: '(?:@\$|\$@)"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.begin.cs
      push: inside-verbatim-format-string-syntax

###[ QUOTED STRINGS ]##########################################################

  inside-string:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.cs string.quoted.double.cs
    - match: '"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: $\n?
      scope: invalid.illegal.unclosed-string.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: string-prototype
    - include: string-escapes
    - include: string-placeholder-escapes
    - include: string-guids
    - include: extended-string-placeholders

  extended-string-placeholders:
    - match: (?=\{\d)
      branch_point: extended-string-placeholder
      branch:
        - extended-string-placeholder
        - string-placeholder-fallback

  extended-string-placeholder:
    - match: (\{)(\d+)
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.placeholder.begin.cs
        2: meta.number.integer.decimal.cs constant.numeric.value.cs
      set: inside-extended-string-placeholder

  inside-extended-string-placeholder:
    - meta_scope: constant.other.placeholder.cs
    - include: string-placeholder-end
    - include: string-placeholder-formatspec
    - include: string-placeholder-width
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: extended-string-placeholder

  string-placeholder-formatspec:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      push: inside-extended-string-placeholder-formatspec

  inside-extended-string-placeholder-formatspec:
    - meta_scope: meta.format-spec.cs
    - meta_content_scope: constant.other.format-spec.cs
    - include: string-escapes
    - include: string-placeholder-escapes
    - match: (?=\})
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=["{])
      fail: extended-string-placeholder

###[ QUOTED FORMAT STRINGS ]###################################################

  inside-format-string:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.interpolated.cs string.quoted.double.cs
    - match: '"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - match: $\n?
      scope: invalid.illegal.unclosed-string.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: string-prototype
    - include: string-escapes
    - include: string-placeholder-escapes
    - include: string-interpolations
    - include: invalid-string-placeholders

  string-interpolations:
    - match: (?=\{)
      branch_point: string-interpolation
      branch:
        - string-interpolation
        - string-placeholder-fallback

  string-interpolation:
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.interpolation.begin.cs
      set: inside-string-interpolation

  inside-string-interpolation:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.interpolation.cs
    - meta_content_scope: source.cs
    - include: string-interpolation-end
    - include: string-interpolation-formatspec
    - include: string-interpolation-width
    - include: parens
    - include: lambdas
    - include: expression-common
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: string-interpolation

  string-interpolation-formatspec:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      push: inside-string-interpolation-formatspec

  inside-string-interpolation-formatspec:
    - meta_scope: meta.format-spec.cs
    - meta_content_scope: constant.other.format-spec.cs
    - include: string-escapes
    - include: string-placeholder-escapes
    - match: (?=\})
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=["{])
      fail: string-interpolation

###[ VERBATIM STRINGS ]########################################################

  inside-verbatim-string-syntax:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.cs string.quoted.double.verbatim.cs
    - match: (?={{sql_indicator}})
      set: inside-verbatim-string-sql
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: inside-verbatim-string-plain

  inside-verbatim-string-sql:
    - meta_scope: meta.string.cs
    - meta_content_scope: source.sql.embedded.cs
    - match: '"(?!")'
      scope: string.quoted.double.verbatim.cs punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: scope:source.sql.embedded.cs.verbatim-string
      apply_prototype: true

  inside-verbatim-string-plain:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.cs string.quoted.double.verbatim.cs
    - include: verbatim-string-escapes
    - match: '"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: string-prototype
    - include: string-placeholder-escapes
    - include: string-guids
    - include: extended-verbatim-string-placeholders

  extended-verbatim-string-placeholders:
    - match: (?=\{\d)
      branch_point: extended-verbatim-string-placeholder
      branch:
        - extended-verbatim-string-placeholder
        - string-placeholder-fallback

  extended-verbatim-string-placeholder:
    - match: (\{)(\d+)
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.placeholder.begin.cs
        2: meta.number.integer.decimal.cs constant.numeric.value.cs
      set: inside-extended-verbatim-string-placeholder

  inside-extended-verbatim-string-placeholder:
    - meta_scope: constant.other.placeholder.cs
    - include: string-placeholder-end
    - include: extended-verbatim-string-placeholder-formatspec
    - include: string-placeholder-width
    - match: (?=\S)
      fail: extended-verbatim-string-placeholder

  extended-verbatim-string-placeholder-formatspec:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      push: inside-extended-verbatim-string-placeholder-formatspec

  inside-extended-verbatim-string-placeholder-formatspec:
    - meta_scope: meta.format-spec.cs
    - meta_content_scope: constant.other.format-spec.cs
    - include: verbatim-string-escapes
    - include: string-placeholder-escapes
    - match: \\(?:""|[^"])
      scope: constant.character.escape.cs
    - match: (?=\})
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=["{])
      fail: extended-verbatim-string-placeholder

###[ VERBATIM FOMRAT STRINGS ]#################################################

  inside-verbatim-format-string-syntax:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.interpolated.cs string.quoted.double.verbatim.cs
    - match: (?={{sql_indicator}})
      set: inside-verbatim-format-string-sql
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: inside-verbatim-format-string-plain

  inside-verbatim-format-string-sql:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.interpolated.cs
    - meta_content_scope: source.sql.embedded.cs
    - match: '"(?!")'
      scope: string.quoted.double.verbatim.cs punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: scope:source.sql.embedded.cs.verbatim-format-string
      apply_prototype: true

  inside-verbatim-format-string-plain:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.interpolated.cs string.quoted.double.verbatim.cs
    - include: verbatim-string-escapes
    - match: '"'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: string-prototype
    - include: string-placeholder-escapes
    - include: verbatim-string-interpolations
    - include: invalid-string-placeholders

  verbatim-string-interpolations:
    - match: (?=\{)
      branch_point: verbatim-string-interpolation
      branch:
        - verbatim-string-interpolation
        - string-placeholder-fallback

  verbatim-string-interpolation:
    - match: \{
      scope: punctuation.section.interpolation.begin.cs
      set: inside-verbatim-string-interpolation

  inside-verbatim-string-interpolation:
    - clear_scopes: 1
    - meta_scope: meta.interpolation.cs
    - meta_content_scope: source.cs
    - include: string-interpolation-end
    - include: verbatim-string-interpolation-formatspec
    - include: string-interpolation-width
    - include: parens
    - include: lambdas
    - include: expression-common
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: verbatim-string-interpolation

  verbatim-string-interpolation-formatspec:
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.colon.cs
      push: inside-verbatim-string-interpolation-formatspec

  inside-verbatim-string-interpolation-formatspec:
    - meta_scope: meta.format-spec.cs
    - meta_content_scope: constant.other.format-spec.cs
    - include: verbatim-string-escapes
    - include: string-placeholder-escapes
    - match: \\(?:""|[^"])
      scope: constant.character.escape.cs
    - match: (?=\})
      pop: 1
    - match: (?=["{])
      fail: verbatim-string-interpolation

  verbatim-string-escapes:
    - match: '""'
      scope: constant.character.escape.cs

###[ RAW STRINGS ]#############################################################

  inside-triple-quoted-raw-string-syntax:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.cs string.quoted.double.block.cs
    - match: (?={{sql_indicator}})
      set: inside-triple-quoted-raw-string-sql
    - match: (?=\S)
      set: inside-triple-quoted-raw-string-plain

  inside-triple-quoted-raw-string-sql:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.cs
    - meta_content_scope: source.sql.embedded.cs
    - match: '"""'
      scope: string.quoted.double.block.cs punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: scope:source.sql.embedded.cs.raw-string
      apply_prototype: true

  inside-triple-quoted-raw-string-plain:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.cs string.quoted.double.block.cs
    - match: '"""'
      scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.cs
      pop: 1
    - include: string-prototype
    - include: string-placeholder-escapes
    - include: string-guids
    - include: extended-raw-string-placeholders

  inside-raw-string:
    - meta_include_prototype: false
    - meta_scope: meta.string.cs string.quoted.double.block.cs
    - match: \1
